Container.Name: Jarvis
Container.Overview: Jarvis Automation: a private voice assistant server for your home. One container runs the whole server (speech-to-text, the language model, text-to-speech, Pi nodes, the mobile app and the recipes app). Open the WebUI to run the setup wizard, which downloads the models. NVIDIA GPU: install the Nvidia Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters and set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Host networking also gives mDNS discovery for phones and nodes.

Config.Name: API
Config.Description: Nodes, phones and the recipes app

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, models and engines; keep it on a cache pool for speed

Config.Name: JARVIS_CONTAINER
Config.Description: Tells jarvisd it runs in a container

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: all, or a GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin; needs --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters

Config.Name: JARVIS_LEGACY_PORTS
Config.Description: 1 also opens the old per-service ports; map them yourself
